definitions.full: H231. ezob אֵזוֺב noun masculine 1Kin 5:13 hyssop (Mishna אזוב , Aramaic , Arabic Frey., Ethiopic ᵐ5 ὕσσωπος , herb of purging qualities, but perhaps not precise botanical term, see Di Lev 14:6 f; see also Löw 93 ) **probably a kind of wild marjoram ( origanum Muru ) Post Hast. DB Hyssop . — ׳א absolute Exod 12:22 4 t.; אֵזֹב Lev 14:4 4 t.; — hyssop , little plant (contracted אֶרֶז cedar ) 1Kin 5:13 , ׳הָא בַּקִּיר יֹצֵא אֲשֶׁר ; Exod 12:22 (J) א ׳אֲגֻדַּת a bunch of h. for sprinkling blood on doorposts; without אגדת , used in cleansing from leprosy Lev 14:4 , 6 , 49 , 51 , 52 ; burnt with red heifer Num 19:6 ; used in cleansing with ashes of red heifer 19:18 (all P); compare Psa 51:9 בְּא ׳תְּחַטְּאֵנִי וְאֶטְהָ֑ר . אַזְכָּרָה see זכר .
